name: laravel-toaster-magic
description: Teaches the agent to add, configure and debug Laravel Toaster Magic toast notifications: setup, PHP/JS/Livewire APIs, themes, security rules and the animated icon preset catalogue.
suggestedPrompts: Add a success toast after this controller saves the record
Show a toast from this Livewire component when the form is submitted
Pick an animated preset for a failed payment toast and enable its pack
